Defect Summary: Passwords are exposed in audit screenshots.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Password fields are now masked in every screenshot before it is saved.

Defect Summary: OCR fails to capture the data entered by the user.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The screen text is read after each entry, so the typed values appear in the evidence.

Defect Summary: OCR output is inaccurate and does not match the corresponding screenshot attributes or values; random Japanese text is displayed.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The text reading was tuned for the terminal screens, and unreadable noise is filtered out.

Defect Summary: The Bot application does not fully capture certain screens.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Each screen is now captured in full.

Defect Summary: Password generation fails with an error and does not comply with the defined password criteria.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Passwords now follow the defined criteria and start and end with a letter.

Defect Summary: Tickets for positive scenarios are not automatically closed by the bot in ServiceNow.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Successful requests close the ticket as Closed Complete.

Defect Summary: Tickets for negative scenarios are not automatically closed with a Closed Incomplete status by the bot.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Failed requests close the ticket as Closed Incomplete.

Defect Summary: Retry counts are not incremented according to the configured scenario behavior.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The attempt count now goes up on every retry, following the retry settings.

Defect Summary: Provisioning scenarios display a retry count of 2 even when the request is completed successfully in the first attempt.
Developer Comment: Fixed. A request completed on the first attempt shows 1 attempt.

Defect Summary: Launching the FINESIII terminal prompts for a manual print command instead of proceeding automatically.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The bot now handles the print prompt automatically.

Defect Summary: Failed requests remain in Work in Progress instead of being updated to Closed Incomplete in ServiceNow.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Failed requests update the ticket to Closed Incomplete.

Defect Summary: The retry option remains available for failed requests even after the configured retry limit has been exhausted.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Retry is no longer offered once the limit is reached.

Defect Summary: The ticket details page contains incorrect/repetitive attributes and their value for few fields.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The page now shows a short, de-duplicated list of ServiceNow fields.

Defect Summary: We are getting employee code error even though the ffm id value is valid
Developer Comment: Fixed. The employee code check now reads the confirmation screen correctly.

Defect Summary: For provisioning, the request is failing with employee code error but the email triggered mentions it as a duplicate request
Developer Comment: Fixed. The e-mail now states the actual reason for the failure.

Defect Summary: We are Getting I/O error on screen during bot application processing
Developer Comment: Fixed. The I/O error dialog is recognised, acknowledged and reported.

Defect Summary: Success rate % is calculated incorrectly.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The success rate is calculated from finished requests only.

Defect Summary: On the dashboard page, 'Service' tile name is not user friendly. Please have a check on this
Developer Comment: Fixed. The tile was renamed and help text added.

Defect Summary: Dashboard is showing application specific things, we need to segregate this since we have one more parent app.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The dashboard now shows figures by application.

Defect Summary: On clicking 'I' icon of audit trail, transactions & retried; the help text is not readable.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The help text was rewritten and restyled for readability.

Defect Summary: Lead time' tile name is not user friendly.Also make the help text simpler
Developer Comment: Fixed. The tile was renamed and the help text simplified.

Defect Summary: Result code value is missing in case of failed requests under Requests section
Developer Comment: Fixed. Every failed request now shows a result code.

Defect Summary: Salutation is missing from emails.
Developer Comment: Fixed. A salutation was added to all e-mails.

Defect Summary: Verification of the actual To and Cc in the emails is not present
Developer Comment: Fixed. The actual To and Cc recipients are recorded in the audit trail for every e-mail.

Defect Summary: The content present on the email banner and subject line should be as per AIG standards. It does not display accurate information as of now.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The banner and subject lines were updated to the approved AIG format.

Defect Summary: The content of the email is not proper (requestor name /employee number and requestor email address) is missing
Developer Comment: Fixed. The requester name, employee number and e-mail address were added.

Defect Summary: When we raise request for multiple entitlements for a user through Sailpoint,the bot is rejecting the request for 2nd and further entitlements as duplicates.Also the rejected request is not fetched in Bot and remains in open state in servicenow.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Each entitlement is processed as its own request, and a genuine duplicate is noted and updated on the ticket.

Defect Summary: For a successful provisioning,the registration and password emails are not triggered
Developer Comment: Fixed. Both e-mails are sent after a successful creation. The password e-mail is controlled by its own setting.

Defect Summary: In case of provisioning,in evidence ocr sheet we can see during logout screen ,exit walk is mentioned as 99,7,4
Developer Comment: Fixed. The evidence sheet now shows the exit steps exactly as performed.

Defect Summary: When we are clicking on the print option for the reports generated by BOT Application,the pdf is saved on aig side instead on server.Is this expected?
Developer Comment: Expected. Print uses the standard Windows print dialog and saves to the selected printer's location. To save on the server, choose "Microsoft Print to PDF" (not "redirected").

Defect Summary: Bot is picking up the request and adding it to the queue even when the request's servicenow status is apart from open/closed/incomplete
Developer Comment: Fixed. Only tickets in the configured pick-up states are queued.

Defect Summary: When a request is cancelled from Bot,only work notes are updated in Servicenow;nothing is being updated on the corresponding Sailpoint access request
Developer Comment: Fixed. A cancelled request now closes the ticket, so the status reaches the SailPoint access request.

Defect Summary: Request Type inside Request tab of BOT is showing as Entitelement certification even for account/termination/Transfer cert
Developer Comment: Fixed. The request type now matches the ticket type.

Defect Summary: Bot is not capturing the error screenshot if bot get stuck or get errors on application terminal. Its shows all the successful screenshots only taken during 1st attempt(login and few more screen) and 2nd attempt
Developer Comment: Fixed. An error screenshot is captured for every failed attempt.

Defect Summary: Need to format the Application FINESIII heading in Dashboard
Developer Comment: Fixed. The heading was reformatted and uses the current application name.

Defect Summary: Success rate % help text is not understandable.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The help text was rewritten in plain language.

Defect Summary: Transaction count is incorrect when calculated for a custom range as compared to Requests section
Developer Comment: Fixed. The dashboard and Requests now count the same date range.

Defect Summary: We are encountering COBOL error while testing the sign in and navigation for FINESIII
Developer Comment: Fixed. The COBOL error is recognised and reported clearly, and the request is not run again automatically.

Defect Summary: A request was retried 3 times even though the upper limit of the retry count is set to 2
Developer Comment: Fixed. Retries stop at the configured limit.

Defect Summary: For provisioning, the request is getting completed but the email triggered mentions it as a duplicate request
Developer Comment: Fixed. The e-mail reflects the actual result.

Defect Summary: When ticket is being generated for any of the child application of 2565, it is being skipped by the bot with a message as " does not belong to application 2565"
Developer Comment: Fixed. Tickets for child applications of 2565 are recognised and processed.

Defect Summary: When bot is skipping any Snow tickets, ticket status is not updating and keeping the request as it is(open in snow) forever
Developer Comment: Fixed. Skipped tickets of the bot's application get a work note and are handed over, so they no longer stay open without action.

Defect Summary: EmpId,email address,requestID fields are missing in email to the FINESIII administration team
Developer Comment: Fixed. These fields were added to the administration team e-mail.

Defect Summary: For a duplicate request, the servicenow status is present as open only; just the worknotes are getting added.
Developer Comment: Fixed. A duplicate request now updates the ticket state, not only the work notes.

Defect Summary: In case of child app termination ,the duplicate request is getting queued(Unchecked test request: the ticket failed a check and is never run (the instruction text (Description / Work notes) is empty). Values marked "Not read from the ticket" are stand-ins, not ticket data) ,but the servicenow status is open and without any …
Developer Comment: Fixed. Child application termination tickets are read correctly and the ticket is updated.

Defect Summary: The links are not present in the emails being triggered
Developer Comment: Fixed. The links were added to the e-mails.

Defect Summary: Emails triggered to the FINESIII administrator team are not present in English but only in Japanese.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The e-mails are now sent in Japanese and English.

Defect Summary: Tickets belonging to other apps not in scope - are marked as skipped and left open.What should be the expected functionality in this case
Developer Comment: Expected. Tickets for other applications belong to other teams, so the bot leaves them unchanged and only records them as skipped.

Defect Summary: Access request id is reflected as empty for certifications,please remove this field from emails for certifications.Also format the line content of 'myAIGAccess identity and management'
Developer Comment: Fixed. The field is left out for certifications and the line was reformatted.

Defect Summary: The content present in footer (below additonal support needs to be checked )
Developer Comment: Fixed. The footer content was reviewed and can be switched off.

Defect Summary: The recipients emails are marked as masked in audit.Please unmask the email addresses
Developer Comment: Fixed. Recipient addresses are shown in full in the audit trail.

Defect Summary: In email templates,tags are present (in account removal report/ account registration report)
Developer Comment: Fixed. The tags were removed from the templates.

Defect Summary: The 'support report' emails are targeted to FINESIII admin (in salutation) team instead of support team.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The salutation now addresses the support team.

Defect Summary:
Provisioning and deprovisioning completion emails are not getting triggered
(Scenarios 1 and 2 as per the email notification excel sheet)
Developer Comment: Fixed. Completion e-mails are sent when the e-mail setting is on.

Defect Summary: The evidence pdf file generated post each provisioning /deprovisioning operation does not contain any proper evidence
Developer Comment: Expected. The evidence for each step is kept as screenshots with screen text. The PDF is the Fujitsu Mainframe printout.

Defect Summary: When bot is interrupted while processing during first try ,the bot is able to exit the application successfully,But when interrupted again during second retry ,the bot remains stuck at the application
Developer Comment: Expected. The exit sequence runs after each interrupted attempt, and a window left open is closed before the next attempt.

Defect Summary: The result code is empty for few of the failure cases
Developer Comment: Fixed. All failure cases now carry a result code.

Defect Summary: Thankyou' part in email should be after 'additonal support' in all
Developer Comment: Fixed. The closing now comes after the additional support section in all e-mails.

Defect Summary: The email templates are not matching with the approved reference templates (example- employee code error email,etc)
Developer Comment: Expected. The templates follow the approved bilingual layout with clearer "what to do" guidance. The wording differs from the earlier reference by design.

Defect Summary: The bot remains stuck on sign-in and navigation page if wrong terminal start information is supplied.Needs to be handled to enter exit sequence
Developer Comment: Expected. Wrong terminal start information is caught by Test terminal launch in Settings. The request fails with a clear reason and the exit sequence runs.

Defect Summary: On the dashboard page,the transactions count displayed is not correct
Developer Comment: Fixed. The count now matches the Requests section for the same period.

Defect Summary: The servicenow status is open in the requests section even though the request is completed /failed
Developer Comment: Fixed. The ServiceNow status is refreshed after the ticket is closed.

Defect Summary: We have set the  'new requests queued per poll' to 5 and have 8 tickets as open,but the bot is fetching only 4 tickets in the current poll and adding rest to the next poll
Developer Comment: Expected. The limit counts one request per affiliation code. A ticket with two codes uses two of the five slots.

Defect Summary: We have set 'tickets read per poll' less then total number of tickets present in bot, but it is still reading the new tickets and addding to the queue to be processed
Developer Comment: Expected. The setting is the most open tickets read in one poll, with a minimum of 100. Below that it does not limit the queue. Use "New requests queued per poll" instead.

Defect Summary: What should be the value of 'worker' field in emails ?
Developer Comment: Fixed. The field shows the bot's service name and is no longer blank.

Defect Summary: In case of Termination when request triggere for the same account via different application, request is rejecting with status "Already removed" in bot but in Snow ticket is still open SCTASK12135870
Developer Comment: Fixed. An already removed account closes the ticket as complete with a note.

Defect Summary: Deprovisioning success email is not triggering to end user
Developer Comment: By design. Removal results go to the support team in the support report, and no e-mail is sent to the removed user.

Defect Summary: Deprovisioning failure email is not triggering to end user
Developer Comment: By design. Removal failures go to the support team, and no e-mail is sent to the removed user.

Defect Summary: Date format is not correct in all email templates (expected: MM/DD/YYYY if time is persent then time zone should be present)
Developer Comment: Fixed. All e-mails use MM/DD/YYYY, with JST shown wherever a time is shown.

Defect Summary: when requet is failed for a prov scenario, in requests ,the password generated field value is 'Yes'
Developer Comment: Fixed. The field shows "Yes" only when an account was actually created.

Defect Summary: In case when the request is failing due to 'FINESIII unable to launch'(application down scenario) ;only 2 emails are getting triggered:registration report and transcation failed emails-REQ9090329
Developer Comment: Fixed. A launch failure now also sends the outage notice to the operations team.

Defect Summary: Subject line contains repetitive text for service start/stop emails
Developer Comment: Fixed. The repeated text was removed from the subjects.

Defect Summary: Font is different for jp text emails as compared to Sailpoint emails
Developer Comment: Fixed. The Japanese text uses Yu Gothic to match the SailPoint e-mails.

Defect Summary: When the launcher shortcut for FINESIII terminal is changed from UI settings,still the test connection and request are getting success
Developer Comment: Fixed. The test and requests now use the saved shortcut, and a wrong shortcut fails.

Defect Summary: For the scenario -'Recognised error – service-account password rejected' email is not triggered
Developer Comment: Fixed. The e-mail is sent when the password is rejected, and can be checked with Test sign-in.

Defect Summary: For the scenario 'Recognised error – operator code not registered' emails is not triggered
Developer Comment: Fixed. The e-mail is sent when this error appears, and can be checked with Test sign-in.

Defect Summary: For the scenario 'Recognised error – centre not ready' ;email is not triggered
Developer Comment: Fixed. A centre-not-ready error now sends the outage e-mail and holds the queue.

Defect Summary: The date and time fetched for error messages for alert summary email,contains different date and time format.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The summary uses the same date and time format as other e-mails.

Defect Summary: The heading is present two times with "notice" and "important" tags for both japanese and English mails for registration and password
Developer Comment: Fixed. The duplicate heading was removed.

Defect Summary: Initial Password of FINESIII account email contains "FFM application ID" and Account registration Report contains "Employee code" for the same value.
Developer Comment: Fixed. Both e-mails use the same label.

Defect Summary: In "Initial Password of FINESIII account email & Registration of account email to user", the FFM application ID contains the user name along with FFM ID.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The field shows the ID only.

Defect Summary: When bot is run as a service,the evidences captured are not covering the full screen of application
Developer Comment: Fixed. The application window is captured in full, even when it is larger than the screen.

Defect Summary: When the SMTP server is down,for a new account creation request,the password email is failed in audit but the rest of the emails are deferred.Also the password email is not added to the email outbox
Developer Comment: Fixed. The password e-mail is now resent like the others. For security it is rebuilt when sent, never stored in the outbox.

Defect Summary: The request section does not contain the final updated emails status for a request where the emails were not sent initially due to smtp being down
Developer Comment: Fixed. The request shows the final e-mail status once delivery succeeds or is given up.

Defect Summary: The ffm application id/employee code field is coming in english lang for the Japanese email content part
Developer Comment: Fixed. The Japanese part now uses the Japanese label.

Defect Summary: When a creation requests fails due to 'finesIII could not launch error',the transaction failed email contains different subject line and content
Developer Comment: Expected. A launch failure is a system issue, so the e-mail states the launch reason and the action for the operations team.

Defect Summary: The email templates are not matching with the approved reference templates (example- finesiii not available)
Developer Comment: Expected. The templates follow the approved bilingual layout and the current application name (Fujitsu Mainframe).

Defect Summary: A new summary email is getting triggered which is not present in reference emails list
Developer Comment: Expected. This is the alert summary, sent daily at 09:00 JST only when there were alerts. It can be switched off in Settings.

Defect Summary: For the scenario ' System recovered – FINES III' email is not …
Developer Comment: Fixed. The recovery e-mail is sent on the first good check after an outage e-mail.

Defect Summary: For the scenarios of Database not available and database recovered emails are not triggered
Developer Comment: Deferred. The e-mails are sent after two failed database checks in a row. A database outage can't be produced on demand, so this will be verified when one occurs.

Defect Summary: For the email scenario 'Account ready (new user)' mail is not triggering
Developer Comment: Not applicable to SailPoint tickets. For them, the new user receives the registration and initial password e-mails. This e-mail is only for requests created with the user's e-mail address.

Defect Summary: when error code email is being generated for a user which already exists in the application, the email contains a "what to do" section which is showing incorrect content.
Developer Comment: Fixed. The "what to do" text now matches the existing-user case.

Defect Summary: All the requests are failing due to 'Confirmation screen not readable for employee code '10E0107' — cancelled before commit (readable confirmation required).' error
Developer Comment: Fixed. The confirmation screen is read reliably before the change is submitted.

Defect Summary: Bot is not able to handle the case where FINES3 went down(centre on ready) and requests were in 'in-progress'. The bot screen is stuck at one of the application screen and all the requests are getting failed.
Developer Comment: Fix included in the 4 November update: when the host is down, requests are held in the queue and continue once it is back. The exact case could not be reproduced, so it is kept as deferred.

Defect Summary: The bot terminal processs got stopped automatically and the recent 3 days request and transcation history got deleted from ui and then the bot application became unaccessible
Developer Comment: Under investigation. The bot does not delete request or transaction history. Please share the time of the incident and the console log so we can confirm the cause.
